tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga la brten nas phung po bsreg sbyong bya tshul mdor bsdus bltas chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru nā tha ak+ṣo bh+ya pā da ya/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das mgon po mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas gzhan rgyud kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod par 'dod pa dag gis/ ro sreg gi cho ga nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ de yang jo bo'i gzhung las/ gshin po yin na brab par bya// zhes dang*/ gzungs nyid las/ sa'am yungs kar ram chu gang yang rung ba la bzlas brjod byas te/ shi ba'i lus la gtor ram/ khrus byas la de'i 'og tu bsregs pa'am/ zhes gsungs pa'i don lag len du bya bar 'dod pa dag gis/ dang por sbyin sreg gi thab 'du bya ba ni/ brtsig thab bru thab sogs sam/ ma grub na stegs bu mnyam par thig chen brgyad btab la dbus nas sor bcu gnyis dang bzhi pa gnyis rim gyis zlum skor byas pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi thig gdab cing sna tshogs pad mar byas pa'i dbus su rdo rje sngon po/ 'dab brgyad kyi shar nas g.yas bskor du dpal be'u sogs rtags brgyad/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje mtshan pa bri'o// de nas bzungs bzlas pa'i chus phung po la gtor zhing khrus byas/ ras dkar dri ma med pa'i gos kyis dkris/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ gro ga'am shog bu sogs la bris pa'i gzungs sngags kyang snying gar btags me tog gis brgyan te thab kyi dbus su so phag gam rdo yi stegs la bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis kha nub tu bstan te bzhag /thab kyi mtha' nas so phag dkar po dri zhim pos bsgos la mchod rten gyi tshul gyis brtsig ste pus mo nas rim gyis phra ba lta bu las/ thab kyi shar lho'i mtshams su me sgo dang*/ snying ga'am dpral ba'i thad du sreg rdzas 'bul ba'i skar khung*/ rtse mor du ba 'byung ba'i skar khung bton/ rtsig pa dang rten gyi bar dri zhim po'i bud shing mar khus sbag pa dam par brtsigs/ g.yas phyogs su bsreg rdzas dang*/ g.yon phyogs su mchod pa/ gtor ma/ rdor dril/

bsang chu/ dkar gtor bcas bsham/ mdun du mar khu'i snod dang ku sha'i chun po/ dgang blug rnams bkod/ sgrub pa po gos dkar po gyon cing thab kyi mdun du bde ba'i gdan la kha shar du phyogs pas rdo rje skyil krung gis 'dug la/ bdag mdun bum sgrub dbang blang ba sogs grub nas/ dkar gtor la/ a kā ro sa byin brlab/ na maḥsarba ta thā sogs kyis bsngos nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong la sogs// 'byung po mthu bo che dag la// 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes nas kyang*// dmigs yul lan chags yongs dag cing*// rnal 'byor 'dod don kun 'grub nas// bdag gi dge ba'i sdong grogs mdzad// ces gtor ma btang zhing*/ a mṛ ta brjod pas srung bar byas la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sogs kyis bsreg rdzas mchod pa lhan cig tu byin gyis brlab/ skad cig nri yig yongs gyur las/ sogs dbang bskur gyi bar byas la/ bsang chus gtor zhing bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dbus su pad+ma dang ra skyes kyi gdan la me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ g.yon gnyis phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa me lce stong gis dkris shing 'od 'bar bar gyur/ de nas tshe 'das rgyud kyi sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes pas me sbar/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi zhing bde legs mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra sa twa aḥ zhes ku sha'i chun po thab kyi kha khyer la g.yas bskor du bkod/ chun po gcig thab kyi nang rtse mo shar du bstan la bzhag /mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bo srin lag gi rtsar g.yob cing*/

oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dz+wa sarba karma ar+tha swa dha ka kā ru na kṛ ta ma hā te dza sā dha ka a smin san ni hi to bha wa dzaḥ hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kīs dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// me lha'i lce dang dgang blugs kyi khar ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ lag g.yon khu tshur gyi hūm̐ bsgreng ba gan rkyal gyis dgang gzar bzung*/ g.yas khu tshur gyis blugs gzar mar khus bkang ba'i bdun nam gsum dgang gzar ba blug /lag gnyis brtsegs te pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar g.yas su lan gsum bskor nas/ oṃ ag+na ye ha bya ka bya wa ha na ya a dī bya swā hā/ zhes mar khu dgang gzar gsum mam bdun phul/ me'i mtshan ma brtags la ngan na bdun rtsi 'khyil ba'i bsang chus bsangs/ yam shing sogs bsreg rdzas rnams g.yas pa'i oṃ hrīḥ sbyar bas 'bul zhing*/ yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swā hā/ de bzhin du mar khu/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ til dang yungs kar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra swā hā/ 'bras ma grus pa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya swā hā/ zas mchog / oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ ku sha / oṃ a pra ti ha ta ya swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu be swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā/ nas dang so ba/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ shing tog / oṃ badz+ra shri ba yai swā hā/ zhes pa rnams bdun nam nyer gcig re phul la so so'i mthar/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu// son pa'i dmigs yul sgo gsum gyi// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs// sarba shit+naṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes btag cing*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong sogs kyi skabs 'dod gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes ltung dang*// 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun phyogs// sarba shit+naṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bsgyur ba btags/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga ni/ drang srong me lha'i lto ba ru// bh+rām̐ las gzhal yas khang pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ dbus su pad+ma zla gdan ste// rang lha'i sa bon sogs nas/ bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur// gyi bar mdun bskyed ltar bya/ de nas/ na mo bha ga wa te ak+ṣo bh+ya ya ta thā ga ta ya r+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dhā ya ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya a dī bya swā hā/ zhes mar khu dgang gzar gsum mam bdun gyis byon zan 'bul/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal ba zla ba dri ma med pa'i sku// sogs kyis bstod pa bya zhing*/ yam shing sogs bsreg rdzas rnams g.yas pa'i oṃ hrīḥ sbyar bas 'bul zhing*/ yam shing*/ na mo bha ga wa te ak+ṣo bh+ya yā ta tha ga ta ya r+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dhā ya oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ya swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ til dang yungs kar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra swā hā/ 'bras ma grus pa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya swā hā/ zas mchog / oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ ku sha / oṃ a pra ti ha ta ya swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu be swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swā hā/ nas dang so ba/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ shing tog / oṃ badz+ra shri ba ye swā hā/ gzungs sngags kyi mthar sreg rdzas kyi sngags btags pa la rim bzhin spel tshig bcas brgya rtsa sogs gang 'os phul ba'i so so'i mthar/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu// son pa'i dmigs yul sgo gsum gyi// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs/ sarba shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes dang dkyus la gong ltar bdag cag dpon slob sogs kyi 'dod gsol btags/

slar yang*/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal ba zla ba sogs kyis bstod nas/ gtor ma'i steng du a las zla dkyil dbus// hūm̐ las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phros pas// gtor mar thim pas gtor ma ye shes kyi/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par gyur// bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ de nyid bcom ldan ljags rtse'i 'od zer gyis// drangs te gsol bas mchog tu mnyes par gyur/ bar bsam te/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// las sgrib ma lus byang ba dang*// mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub kun// myur du thob par mdzad gsol// zhes pas 'dod don gsol/ bcom ldan cho ga 'i bya ba la// ma tshang ba dang lhag pa dang*// 'gal zhing 'khrul pa ci mchis pa// kun nas bzod par mdzad du gsol// zhes nongs pa bshags shing*/ khyod kyi sems can sogs kyis slar 'byon par gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ slar me lha la bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams 'bul zhing*/ yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye bha dhi brik+ṣa ya swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ til dang yungs kar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ta na badz+ra ye swā hā/ 'bras ma grus pa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya swā hā/ zas mchog / oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ ku sha / oṃ a pra ti ha ta ya swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu be swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swā hā/ nas dang so ba/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ shing thog / oṃ badz+ra shri ba ye swā hā/ zhes pa rnams bdun nam nyer gcig re phul la so so'i mthar gong ltar 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu/ sogs kyi 'dod gsol btags/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa rī bā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kīs dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud//

ces bstod/ me lha la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ a kā ro sogs/ oṃ ag+na sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba lim ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis mchod/ bstod pa/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// kyis 'dod don gsol/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol bya/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyi bsgrub kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar byon te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol zhing bsngo smon bkra shis bya'o// de ltar cho ga'i rim pa nub gcig la sgrub kyang rung zhing*/ yang sreg khang brtsegs pa yan nub dang po/ me sbar ba phyin nub gnyis pa byed pa yin la/ rten bskyed cing phyir ldog sdig sbyong dbang bskur sogs sngon du byas zin na 'dir byed mi dgos shing bdag bskyed kho nas chog go /de nas tshe 'das kyi rus pa la sāts+tsha gdab cing ming yig bcug pa'i mchod rten chur dor ba'am/ lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten chen po bya bar gsungs pa bzhin bya'o// zhes bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga la brten nas phung po bsreg sbyong bya tshul mdor bsdus shig dgos zhes shu gu bla ma karma phun tshogs kyis bskul bzhin/ gar dbang drug pa'i cho ga'i lhan thabs kyi tshul du dpal chen chos kyi don grub kyis re gzigs su bkod pa 'dis kyang sems can kun ma rig pa'i dri ma bsreg cing ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas par gyur cig /maṅga lam/ ༈ swa sti/ sgrib gnyis sreg byed khyad 'phags gong ma'i gsung*// 'di yang bla ma don kun grub pa yis// spar du bsgrubs dges mkha' mnyam ma rnams kun// mngon dga'i zhing du rdzogs byang brnyes gyur cig// /
